items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Sounds somewhat like Edmund a little bit. [INTERVIEWEE] He does. Almost exactly. Is he younger than Edmund? Oh, yes. A whole lot younger. He's one of the younger brothers.

ctx.x: Sounds somewhat like Edmund a little bit.
He does. Almost exactly. Is he younger than Edmund? Oh, yes. A whole lot younger. He's one of the younger brothers.
There's still a couple of them over there. Clarence Hall, I think, is a male man. That's right.
